embeds.title: 🟡 Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN Auth Bypass Flaw Now Exploited in Attacks
embeds.description:
Palo Alto Networks reports that CVE-2026-0257, a GlobalProtect authentication bypass flaw, is now being actively exploited in attacks against unpatched PAN-OS devices. Rapid7 observed successful exploitation across numerous customers starting May 17, 2026, with attackers using forged authentication override cookies to authenticate to GlobalProtect gateways. While attackers were able to connect via VPN in some cases, Rapid7 did not observe successful lateral movement from the devices.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer, Risky Biz News • 🟢 3 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-0257 • **Access:** Authentication bypass via forged authentication override cookies
**Incident date:** 2026-05-17 • **Confidence:** reported
[Read source](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/palo-alto-globalprotect-vpn-auth-bypass-flaw-now-exploited-in-attacks/)
